meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先读取仓库当前状态,把请求归入提交、改写历史、查历史、看状态四类模式;只有你明确要求才执行提交、rebase、推送等写操作,否则只报调查结果,并给出版本哈希和命令证据。
howto.when: 当任务需要做提交或调查 Git 历史时触发;只在明确要求时才执行改写、推送等写操作,普通代码编辑不适用。

say.text: 把这些改动拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 会先按本地历史风格判断消息格式

say.text: 查一下这行代码是谁最后改的
say.note: 用 blame 给出提交哈希和改动内容

say.text: 把最近三次提交合并成一个
say.note: 若分支已推送会先问你是否强推

howto.what_en: Claude reads the repo state first, sorts the request into commit, history-rewrite, history-lookup, or status mode, and only writes to Git when you explicitly ask; otherwise it reports findings with hashes and command evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task needs a commit or a Git-history investigation; skipped for ordinary code edits. Rewriting protected branches needs your explicit ask.

say_en.text: Split these changes into several atomic commits
say_en.note: Matches the repo's recent message style

say_en.text: Who last changed this line of code?
say_en.note: Uses git blame with hash and diff

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one
